features.name: main.py — process launcher
features.detail: argparse CLI: default starts API+UI+Scout; --api-only / --ui-only / --scout / --init-db. UTF-8 reconfigures stdout/stderr. Runs init_database() first, then Scout scheduler, synthesis keep-warm thread + scheduler, API thread (uvicorn), UI in main thread.

features.name: Synthesis keep-warm
features.detail: Pre-loads + re-pings the local 26B synthesis model every keep_warm_interval_minutes (20) so the first real synthesis isn't a ~25-30s cold start. Config-gated by core.synthesis_keep_warm.

features.name: QI_NEXUS NSSM service
features.detail: Service QI_NEXUS, AppDirectory C:\APPS\NEXUS, runs main.py. Logs to C:\APPS\NEXUS\LOGS\nexus_service.log + nexus_service_error.log. Public via QI_NEXUSTunnel (Cloudflare, UI 7880).

features.name: GET / · /health · /version · /info
features.detail: Status + ecosystem endpoints. /info reads qi_registry.json and returns the nexus project entry. /version reports project=nexus, version=0.1.0.

features.name: POST /synthesize
features.detail: Primary endpoint. SynthesizeRequest{prompt, provider_ids?, include_raw, routing_mode(parallel|chain|iterative), iterations, enable_judge, judge_provider, judge_mode, persona_map, inference_mode, mode_map, synthesis_instruction}. Persists session row.

features.name: POST /synthesize/stream
features.detail: SSE variant. Emits provider_pending -> provider_result (as_completed) -> heartbeat (every 5s) -> synthesis -> [DONE]. Parallel and chain stream per-step; iterative falls through.

features.name: POST /judge
features.detail: Scores pre-collected responses. mode=simple (1 LLM call, markdown table) or deepeval (G-Eval). Effective mode: request > nexus.json scorer.mode > simple.

features.name: Dispatcher — parallel asyncio
features.detail: Lazy-loads providers (double-checked lock). asyncio.gather(return_exceptions=True) so one raising adapter can't lose the others. Returns DispatchResult with .successful/.failed. Resolves per-provider mode (mode_map > inference_mode).

features.name: Dispatcher — chain & stream
features.detail: chain_dispatch feeds each provider the previous successful answer to improve. dispatch_stream is an async generator yielding ProviderResponse via asyncio.as_completed.

features.name: Synthesizer
features.detail: Primary/fallback providers from nexus.json (core.synthesis_provider=ollama/gemma4:26b, fallback=chatgpt). PROVIDER_REGISTRY maps config name -> class. FALLBACK_SYNTHESIS_PROMPT preserves tables/code; single OK response returned verbatim; last resort concatenates.

features.name: Inference-mode registry
features.detail: Single source of truth for Fast/Balanced/Thinking/Deep. CAPABILITY_RULES matches (adapter, model_substring) -> supported modes + default. MODE_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER (fast 0.6 .. deep 10x), MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1800.

features.name: Scheduler
features.detail: APScheduler wrapper started at API startup. Registers one IntervalTrigger job per enabled Scout topic (id scout_<topic>), plus scheduled prompt jobs. Per-topic run_interval_hours overrides the global default.

features.name: Batch runner
features.detail: Runs a batch of prompts through dispatch+synthesis; per-prompt logs; per_prompt / per_model log modes. Backed by batch_jobs + batch_results tables.

features.name: NexusProvider ABC + ProviderResponse
features.detail: Abstract base every adapter implements: async generate(prompt, system_prompt?, inference_mode?) -> ProviderResponse{provider_id, provider_name, text, status, latency_ms, error_message, .ok}. load_providers(role_filter) in __init__.py reads providers.json.

features.name: ChatGPT (openai_codex)
features.detail: gpt-4o-mini via OpenAI API. role=[dispatch, synthesis]. Used as synthesis fallback.

features.name: Groq
features.detail: llama-3.3-70b-versatile. Default judge provider. timeout 30s.

features.name: Mistral
features.detail: mistral-small-latest. Magistral models advertise thinking modes.

features.name: Ollama (local) x2
features.detail: Two registered: ollama (qwen3:4b, fast local + scout_synthesis) and gemma4 (gemma4:26b, primary synthesiser). base_url 127.0.0.1:11434, no key. ollama_keep_alive=30m.

features.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
features.detail: @cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast. Free tier; authed via OC credentials. role includes scout_synthesis.

features.name: Gemini
features.detail: gemini-2.0-flash. Disabled 2026-06-12 — free-tier quota 0 (429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED); replaced by local gemma4:26b. Re-enable on key renewal.

features.name: Grok
features.detail: grok-3-mini via xAI. Enable once a free-tier key is configured.

features.name: Generic OpenAI-compatible
features.detail: Drives OpenRouter, Perplexity, Cohere, Together, Fireworks, NVIDIA NIM via base_url+model+env_key. All registered but disabled pending keys; addable at runtime via POST /config/provider/add.

features.name: Anthropic / Azure / Bedrock
features.detail: Pre-wired adapters, disabled. Need keys (+ pip install anthropic / boto3). Bedrock currently treats inference_mode as no-op (balanced only).

features.name: Config endpoints (hot-reload)
features.detail: Read + write nexus.json / providers.json / secrets nexus.env. Provider add/delete/update hot-reloads the dispatcher (_loaded=False). Built-in providers can't be deleted, only disabled.

features.name: Provider capability matrix
features.detail: capabilities returns supported modes + default per provider for the Orchestrator mode dropdowns; detail returns model/timeout/role/active.

features.name: Sessions & history
features.detail: Recent sessions, single fetch, single + bulk delete (older_than all|1d|7d|30d|90d) with FK-safe child cleanup.

features.name: Personas CRUD
features.detail: Merges built-in personas.json (locked) + user_personas.json. _build_system_prompt() auto-generates a prompt from persona fields if none supplied.

features.name: Logs tail
features.detail: Tails per-subsystem rotating log (scorer.log, dispatcher.log) or shared nexus.log. Capped 5000 lines.

features.name: Scout runner
features.detail: Per-topic or all-topics. Cycle: fetch -> deduplicate -> filter_unique -> INSERT OR IGNORE into scout_items -> generate_digest -> save .docx -> INSERT OR REPLACE scout_digests. _migrate_db() adds topic_id columns idempotently at import.

features.name: Scout fetcher
features.detail: Topic-aware. Sources: feedparser RSS, Reddit, Hacker News (Algolia API). Topics persisted in config/scout_topics.json. Default topic ai_news is_default and non-deletable.

features.name: Deduplicator + digest
features.detail: deduplicate(threshold=85) via rapidfuzz; generate_digest() + save_digest_docx() (python-docx) produce the markdown + Word digest.

features.name: Scout API
features.detail: Topic CRUD re-registers APScheduler jobs on interval/enabled change. /scout/run triggers a cycle (topic_id optional). OPML import parses xmlUrl outlines into a new topic.

features.name: Bench runner
features.detail: Runs each case x provider via Dispatcher, optionally scores with core.scorer, persists bench_provider_runs + bench_results, computes mean_score/mean_latency. recommend() ranks providers by AVG(mean_score). Starter suite of 5 cases auto-seeded.

features.name: Bench API
features.detail: Full suite/case CRUD + run + history + recommendation. 4 provider runs and 20 results currently recorded.

features.name: DeepEval scorer
features.detail: NexusJudge wraps any registered provider as a DeepEvalBaseLLM. Runs Clarity/Accuracy/Depth G-Eval concurrently per response with per-metric timeout (scorer.metric_timeout_seconds=90). Raises to trigger simple-mode fallback if all metrics fail. DEEPEVAL_AVAILABLE guards the optional dep.

features.name: RAG store
features.detail: ChromaDB PersistentClient at data/rag, collection nexus_knowledge, cosine HNSW, DefaultEmbeddingFunction. init()+ingest_jsonl() run in a daemon thread with a 300s deadline at startup so a hung ChromaDB never blocks boot.

features.name: RAG API + curate
features.detail: Query top-N chunks with min_relevance; curate/export appends to knowledge/nexus_curated.jsonl and auto-ingests; upload/extract pulls text from uploaded files.

features.name: DB layer + schema
features.detail: init_db() applies schema + idempotent migrations. SQLite WAL, foreign_keys ON. schema_version at v4 (bench tables added 2026-06-13). Row factory returns dict-able rows.

features.name: Config + logging
features.detail: get(key, default) dotted-path accessor over nexus.json; reload_config()/load_config() for hot reload. configure_logging() builds per-subsystem rotating file handlers + levels.

features.name: Orchestrator tab
features.detail: Dispatch sub-tab: prompt templates, provider subset, routing mode, iterations, global+per-provider inference mode, judge toggle + scoring method/AI, expert personas, RAG augment toggle, synthesis presets, export. Plus Session History sub-tab.

features.name: Scout tab
features.detail: Topic selector; Daily Digest, Raw Feed (source filter), Manage Topics (CRUD + OPML import) sub-tabs.

features.name: Batch & Schedule tab
features.detail: Build & Run, Batch History, Scheduled Jobs, Results Viewer sub-tabs.

features.name: Expert Panel tab
features.detail: Panel Designer, Presets, Persona Library, Manage Experts, Evaluate My Work, Write from Research sub-tabs.

features.name: Curate & Export + Bench tabs
features.detail: Curate & Export saves answers to the knowledge library; Bench tab builds/runs suites and shows the recommendation matrix.

features.name: Settings + Help tabs
features.detail: Settings: Providers, API Keys, Core Engine, Scout, Logging, Add Provider. Dynamic scorer tab label reflects mode/enabled. Help & About: Getting Started, per-feature guides, API Reference, About.
